source.description: A robed fire mage with glowing ember accents, standing with hands loosely at the sides, robes swaying gently, small flames flickering around the palms. Seamless loop.
The robed fire mage attacks — flames gather between raised hands into a burning sphere, then the mage hurls the fireball toward the camera, then lowers the hands as the flames die down.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Backfill enemy (character existed pre-session with no animations); idle+attack generated this session via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
